title: Tight-knit Game Dev Play Testing Discord
author: BomcatTommy
selftext:
Yo! I hope this is allowed here, and yes I saw the reddit has it's own discord.

A group of devs from a few jams I've attended and I decided to make a play testing server for each other to try each other's games and give feedback. A lot of the Play testing servers out there are full of hundreds of people willing to pay money for you to test their games and give a detailed essay of feedback, not here!

We're about 25 people so far, very active, and looking to lift each other up.

A rising tide lifts all boats

[https://discord.gg/6hF8tXd9](https://discord.gg/6hF8tXd9)
